HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:AHC:74988 Court No. - 73 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 528 BNSS No. - 16232 of 2025 Applicant :- Fariyad Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Satya Narayan Gupta,Yogendra Pal Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant seeks to withdraw the application, wherein challenge has been raised to quash the impugned summoning order dated 26.07.2024 passed by Learned Court of Civil Judge (J.D.) Second/Judicial Magistrate, Hapur, Complaint Case No. 300 of 2023, Computer No.
20574 of 2022 (Gulphasa Vs Fariya and others) under section 498A, 323, 504 IPC and section 3/4 D.P. Act, related to Police Station Pilkhuwa District Hapur on the basis of compromise dated 25.02.2025, due to technical defect with liberty to file fresh.
2. Learned AGA has no objection to the same.
3. The present application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file fresh.
4. Certified copy of the documents be returned to the learned counsel for the applicant subject to furnishing of photocopy of the same.

Order Date :- 8.5.2025 Rajesh  Fariyad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168792339/
